name: debugging-cdp-targets
description: Connect Codex directly to the official Chrome DevTools MCP Server for a verified local CDP target.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect verified local CDP targets with Chrome DevTools
interface.longDescription: Launch a new local Chrome browser or another verified CDP-capable application with the isolation option you choose. Use the official Chrome DevTools tools to capture screenshots, diagnose console and network issues, and inspect performance. Choose Close or Keep when the task ends.
defaultPrompt: Open https://example.com in a new Chrome window and capture a screenshot.
Check console errors and failed requests in a new Chrome window.
Profile page load performance in a new Chrome window.
